name: Volta
old_description: Volta’s Low Voltage (LV) Products include UL1558 Metal Enclosed Switchgear, UL891 Low Voltage Switchboard, and UL845 Motor Control Centers (MCC). Our LV Switchgear is engineered by Volta using circuit breakers from various manufacturers. We can customize your preferred manufacturer of LV MCC to meet your requirements. Switchgear and MCC can be closed coupled with switchgear for an integrated LV system.
about:
Volta operates from Houston, Texas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Volta designs and manufactures low-voltage and medium-voltage electrical power distribution equipment. Its low-voltage lineup includes UL 1558 metal-enclosed switchgear, UL 891 switchboards, and UL 845 motor control centers (MCCs), engineered with circuit breakers from suppliers such as ABB, Eaton, GE, and Siemens. Medium-voltage offerings span 5 kV to 38 kV switchgear, MCCs, and variable-frequency drives, with arc-resistant and gas-insulated options. The company also produces Electrical Equipment Centers (EECs), integrating engineering, fabrication, wiring, and testing under one roof. Facilities encompass two 44,000-square-foot assembly buildings equipped with 20-ton and 40-ton overhead cranes, a dedicated skid fabrication shop for structural welding, and indoor sheet-metal and powder-coating lines that eliminate weather-related delays.

Volta serves the oil-and-gas, petrochemical, and energy sectors, with a customer roster that includes Occidental Oil & Gas, ExxonMobil, Phillips 66, Kinder Morgan, BP North America, and engineering firms such as Bechtel, Jacobs Engineering, and Burns & McDonnell.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model—engineering, manufacturing, integration, and quality control performed in the same facility—as a means to deliver custom designs with reduced lead times. Its IHB certification underscores a standardized, factory-built approach for Electrical Equipment Centers.
